newsitem.title: USA: CNG added to PaineWebber's focus list.
newsitem.headline: CNG added to PaineWebber's focus list.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc's Private Client Group said on Wednesday that it added Consolidated Natural Gas Co to its focus list.
The list, devised by the firm's research department, consists of 30 stocks that PaineWebber believes offer high returns and minimal losses for investors.
PaineWebber estimates the company's full year 1996 earnings at $3.20 a share. In 1995, Consolidated Natural Gas reported net income of $0.23 a share, which included several different charges.
